title: Halberdiers Quarters, Topkapi Palace
visualBrief: Named L-shaped Halberdiers quarters/service range on way32396154. Retain its exact notched exterior and open court outside the L, reconstruct a narrow head court, pale stone outer elevations, selected pale/salmon plaster inner elevations, lead hips, brick/cowl chimneys, projecting upper story with timber corbels, actual entrances and stair approach. No Tower of Justice, independent colonnade, private inscriptions, museum furniture or visitors. The small head courtyard is a picture-led reconstruction within the mapped exterior, not an OSM courtyard survey. The long service range uses three conservative floor steps from the retained grade rather than one oversized plinth. Detailed internal room inventory remains approximate.
